mandatory_boundary_requirements: Actual straight gripped centreline lies on/within the measured bore containment mask through the flat exit; actual wire radius does not exceed measured bore radius.

For this sufficient proof the outgoing actual free-curve centre and unit tangent match the collet exit centre and axis in its registered frame. C0<=.20 and unrestricted C1 alone do NOT establish this boundary condition.
The complete actual centreline, including clamp transitions, satisfies the declared C1/C2 and material-length constraints. No merely positional point-cloud certificate.
actual_shape_extension.scope: Conditional sufficient physical-shape class; not a bench result or an assertion that unqualified hardware enforces exact exit matching. The reference source construction itself matches these endpoint conditions.
actual_shape_extension.theorem: At the actual flat exit register centreline point to the measured collet axis and tangent to that axis. Curvature<=kappa gives a(s)>=s*cos(kappa*s0), transverse rho(s)<=kappa*s²/2 for0<=s<=s0. Thus a²>=2*r*rho by reported inequality. Beyond s0, a>r and strict positive axial derivative follows from reference tangent lower minus|e_s|. Apply at both ends.

allowed_contact_mask.allowed_contact: Own straight wire occupies its own cylindrical bore. Boundary contact at bore/cylinder exit circle is allowed; no material overlap in annulus.
allowed_contact_mask.entry_side: Before the free-curve exit the bridge/tail is straight on the measured bore axis. Metal<=1mm and insulation<=1.2954mm radii fit the declared bore; the occupied bore is an intended contact only.
allowed_contact_mask.near_exit_geometry: With axial a>=m*t and transverse displacement rho<=M*t²/2, a²>=2*r*rho if m²>=r*M. This implies centre distance>=r to the entire annulus radius>=r behind the exit plane, so even a conservative spherical swept tube cannot penetrate that collet annulus. After t0, axial distance>r and stays increasing.
not_exempt: Solder/foil outside separately declared own landing mask
allowed_contact_mask.only_solids: Same board and wire split_collet analytic finite cylinder, with bore radius>=actual wire radius and axial grip1..2.5; subtracting split slots only removes material.

insulation_cut.scope: Own terminal transition has an explicit mask and this residual-clearance calculation. Do not apply an unrelated free-wire nominal0.70mm threshold in addition to the already enumerated closure. Remaining individual fabrication effects must fit the0.45mm allocation; not measured capability.

integration_rule: A checker may omit only the same-wire same-board split_collet pair after authenticating this proof and exact bore/grip/exit primitives. It must still check all other material and all straight/end segments. Unsupported shape/axis/bore edits invalidate the mask.

reference_exclusion.scope: All g/h corner hulls, both ends and Y reflections; floating engineering bound, not formal roundoff certificate.

source_family.transform_scope: Translations, orthogonal Y reflections and reversal preserve all norms/projections; both endpoints explicitly included in exit_proof.
